feature: hexa loop line: one line of loop state for a status bar
description: `hexa loop line` prints one short line of where the work stands, for a status bar redrawn every turn: idle, or the stage as a position on the decide › gate › build › harden track, then the ADR id, the checklist count and a harness run, never text a person recorded. The settings template runs it; `hexa loop` and the hooks are unchanged.

specs.description: With a loop recorded, `hexa loop line` prints exactly one line and exits 0.
specs.given: A project with docs/adrs/ADR-0001-first.md, and in session HEXA_SESSION_ID=s1 `hexa loop adr ADR-0001`, `hexa loop gate 'cargo test'` and two `hexa loop task add` steps recorded.
specs.when: `hexa loop line` is run in the project in session s1.
specs.then: It exits 0 and its stdout is one line ending in a single newline, with no other newline in it.

specs.description: `hexa loop line` writes nothing and does not fail, even with nothing to read.
specs.given: A directory with no .hexa/ at all, and separately a project whose .hexa/loop.json has an entry for session s1.
specs.when: `hexa loop line` is run in each, in session s1.
specs.then: Both runs exit 0 and print one line. The directory still has no .hexa/, and the project's .hexa/loop.json is byte-for-byte what it was before the run.

specs.given: A project with .hexa/ and no loop entry for session s1.
specs.when: `hexa loop line` is run in session s1.
specs.then: Its stdout is exactly "▸ loop · idle\n".

specs.description: The idle line carries no advice and no command, though `hexa loop` still does.
specs.given: A project with .hexa/ and no loop entry for session s1.
specs.when: `hexa loop line` and `hexa loop` are run in session s1.
specs.then: The line contains none of "hexa loop", "Record", "nothing recorded" or a backtick. The output of `hexa loop` still contains "nothing recorded" and "hexa loop gate".

specs.description: The stage is a position on the track, the current one in capitals, then the ADR and the checklist count.
specs.given: In session s1: `hexa loop adr ADR-0001`, `hexa loop gate 'cargo test'` (stage gate), five `hexa loop task add` steps and `hexa loop task done 1`, `hexa loop task done 2`.
specs.when: `hexa loop line` is run; then `hexa loop stage build` and `hexa loop line` again.
specs.then: The first line is exactly "▸ loop · decide › GATE › build › harden · ADR-0001 · 2/5". The second is exactly "▸ loop · decide › gate › BUILD › harden · ADR-0001 · 2/5".

specs.description: Done replaces the track; a live or stalled harness run replaces it too, named by verb and phase, with the ADR and count after it.
specs.given: A loop.json entry for session s1 with stage "done" and adr "ADR-0001"; then one with stage "harden", adr "ADR-0001", tasks [done, todo], and running {verb: harden, phase: verify, message: "3 claims"} started 2 minutes ago and updated now; then the same running record updated 10 minutes ago; then one started 65 minutes ago and updated now.
specs.when: `hexa loop line` is run in session s1 against each.
specs.then: The first is exactly "▸ loop · done · ADR-0001". The second matches "▸ loop · running harden/verify 2mNNs · ADR-0001 · 1/2" and has no "›". The third is exactly "▸ loop · stalled harden/verify · ADR-0001 · 1/2". The fourth contains "running harden/verify 1h05m".

specs.description: What was not recorded is not shown: no ADR, no count, no run means none of their parts.
specs.given: In session s1 only `hexa loop gate 'cargo test'` recorded: no ADR, no tasks, no running record.
specs.then: Its stdout is exactly "▸ loop · decide › GATE › build › harden\n": no "ADR", no "none", no "/" count, no "running".

specs.description: The gate command, the evidence command, task titles and the run's message do not appear.
specs.given: In session s1: gate `cargo test --test domain compose_status 2>&1 | grep -E "test result: ok. [1-9]"`, evidence `echo EVIDENCE-MARK`, a task titled "TITLE-MARK wire the parser" marked doing, and a running record with message "MESSAGE-MARK".
specs.then: The line contains none of "cargo", "grep", "EVIDENCE-MARK", "TITLE-MARK", "MESSAGE-MARK" and is at most 80 characters.

specs.description: `hexa loop` itself still shows the gate command in full.
specs.then: Its output contains the gate command `cargo test --test domain compose_status` and the task title "TITLE-MARK wire the parser".

specs.description: For any recorded gate, evidence, task titles and run message, the line contains none of them and its length does not depend on them.
specs.given: Generated loop.json entries for session s1: a random stage from decide, gate, build, harden, done; an ADR id of the form ADR-NNNNNNNNNN or none; 0 to 30 tasks with random statuses; and a gate, evidence, task titles and running message each a random string of 12 to 400 characters containing a 12-character random marker.
specs.when: `hexa loop line` is run against each of at least 40 such entries.
specs.then: No line contains any marker, and every line is at most 80 characters.

specs.description: The settings template's status bar runs `hexa loop line`.
The template no longer cuts the full report with head.
specs.then: It does not contain "head" and does not end in "hexa loop" or "hexa loop show".
